## Key Deltas in Refresh 5

- **Re-evaluation of existing 1,251 rows**: Fixed 43 stale/parenthetical `file:line` citations (`OPTTriageClosureTests.swift:N`, `WP09PresetsTeamAfterSaleTests.swift:173,187`, 5 `wp-0105` payout rows, 3 `PAGE-*` parentheticals). Downgraded **7 `PAGE-*`** rows (`TicketWalletView` skeleton regression + 6 compile/bind regressions) and **15 `API-*`** rows (`HTTP 404` retired v1 `/api/workshop/purchased`, `501` subscription templates x3, `500` WxACode QR x4, `500 OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` IM media x2, `500` voice ASR x1, `403` NPC chat disabled x1, `500` AppID mismatch x1, `500` CRM broadcast x1, `401 US_SESSION_INVALID` x1) to `IN-PROGRESS`.
- **`APP-CONTRACT-FIXES.md` verification**: Sections §1–§5 (`MerchantContentCommands` JSON, `payout-account/save` removal, `/api/workshop/purchased` lease denial, concrete `{id}` routes, `auditApplication` keys) are already landed on `ui/h-premerge` (`ee0383296`).
- **Group `(a)` Pop-ups (`1,114`)**: `534 DONE` (every `DONE` row resolved to an explicit `App/*.swift:line` on `ee0383296`), `103 IN-PROGRESS` (`DIFFERENT` in `popups-merchant.csv` [101] + `popups-play.csv` [2]), `477 MISSING` (`popups-merchant.csv` [312] + `popups-play.csv` [165]).
- **Group `(b)` 14 Design Templates (`TPL-01`..`TPL-14`)**: `7 DONE` (`T01, T02, T03, T09, T12, T13, T14`) and `7 IN-PROGRESS` (`T04` partial + broken tokens, `T05` `CYTicketPass` `.rare`, `T06` partial + `.scan`/`.free`, `T07` `AccountView` -> broken `MemberScoreAppealListView`, `T08` `TicketWalletView` skeleton regression, `T10` no Group C restyle + bind 500, `T11` `SessionPublishingModesView` -> broken `ActivityEditingView`).
- **Group `(c)` API-Smoke failing rows (`SMOKE-001`..`SMOKE-387`)**: Latest `api-smoke/results.json` (1,234 calls: `640 OK`, `207 BUSINESS-REFUSAL-EXPECTED`, `386 BACKEND-ERROR`, `1 SHAPE-MISMATCH`) reduced failures from 819/626 in `API-SMOKE.md` to **387**. Direct 8120 curls proved **11** failing smoke calls actually answer HTTP 200 with valid parameters and **1** (`GET /api/im/video/message/{}/authorization`) is a `shape_validator.py` false-positive (`Core/IMVideoService.swift:76-81`).
- **Group `(d)` Known Open Test/Compile/CI Failures (`TESTFAIL-01`..`TESTFAIL-12`)**: `7` code/test compile & crash bugs (fixes staged unmerged in `DES-ui` `integ/next` `19072cb0a..18ddef4e1`), `app-failing-20.md` tail (`TESTFAIL-08`), skipped `CouponRuntimeFlowTests` (`TESTFAIL-09`), failing `current_ci.py check` (`TESTFAIL-10`), `186` baseline Python contract ratchet failures (`TESTFAIL-11`), and `shape_validator.py` (`TESTFAIL-12`).
- **Status & Roll-up Rules (`CL-02.R`)**: Every row requires verified `file:line` plus a live TEST `8120` route answer or passing test for `DONE`. Roll-up rows (`OWN-22.1`, `OWN-22.2`, `OWN-十三`, `OWN-十一`, `OWN-十四`, etc.) follow rule `CL-02.R` evaluated by `tools/completeness_rollups.py`.
